notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item in exactly one test (pools exactly 4x each count). Categories follow the four areas of Anexo III (programa de formación previa común) of the 2026 bases (BOE-A-2026-813); the 4/8/5/8/3/5/9/8 split is Tigertest's, roughly in proportion to the annex's 24 legal, 5 socio-professional, 14 technical and 14 instrumental temas. Five topic sets 22601-22605 + 4 tests = 9 dashboard steps. passPct 67 (34 of 50): the real 5 of 10 minimum under [A - E/2] x 10/P, answering every question, needs 67 of 100 right; Tigertest does not apply the penalty and uses four options where the real test has three.
